What you will see

  1. Import four fictional cues into two batches.
  2. Export the prompt to the AI service you choose.
  3. Import a saved JSON reply.
  4. Reject a reply with a deliberately missing ID.
  5. Keep export disabled with only one accepted batch.
  6. Accept all batches and retain original timing.
  7. Download the translated SRT and review it in a player.
  8. Open CueBridge and try the built-in sample.
